title: Software Engineer
description: Enhanced the Geostationary Weather Satellite Antenna Systems (GWSAS) operational weather-product processing under NOAA's $24.6 million Ground Readiness Antennas award and overhauled its deployment process. Reduced upgrades from a full day of engineering effort to less than an hour while diagnosing a customer-site data corruption issue that helped motivate the later RFIMS program.
highlights: Automated deployments and configuration with Ansible, Bash, and YAML, reducing deployment time from a full day to less than one hour.
Enabled customer teams to perform upgrades that had previously required direct engineering support.
Traced corrupted weather products to radio-frequency interference at the receiving antenna.
Connected the interference finding to spectrum overlap near GOES frequencies, helping establish the operational need for RFIMS.
